name: Store plugin (full)
author: LoomWeaver
description: A sandboxed community plugin installed at runtime from the testbed's own catalog. Once installed it has a page at /store-full and a settings section of its own, so the install, settings and uninstall paths are all exercised.

name: Store plugin (minimal)
author: LoomWeaver
description: The smallest possible community plugin: one page at /store-minimal and no settings. It is the contrast case that shows a plugin without settings gets no settings entry.
